title: Closed immersion, finiteness and etaleness are local on the target
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be any open covering of $Y$. For each $i$ let $f_i:f^{-1}(U_i)\to U_i$ be its restriction, equivalently its base change to $U_i$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then (1) $f$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] if and only if every $f_i$ is a closed immersion; (2) $f$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] if and only if every $f_i$ is finite; and (3) $f$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] if and only if every $f_i$ is etale.
